    Convex source support of string coefficient components #

    The forward partial-bijection relation linearly orders each generated coefficient component. Every source-word index between two component vertices is therefore represented by a unique component vertex.

    source

    Relation.ReflTransGen (C.MorphismCoefficientForwardStep D) p q ∨ Relation.ReflTransGen (C.MorphismCoefficientForwardStep D) q p

    Two vertices in one coefficient component are comparable by forward reachability.
